requirements.evidence: Queues component covers the full contract: scoped mount authorization (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:55-58), create with derived slug and reset (:76-90), scoped open/close (:92-106), rename re-deriving the slug (:125-137), confirmation-modal toggle (:143-166), access modal with scoped grant/revoke (:168-224), and view data accessQueue/accessGrants (:193-229). Serve panel implements state, mount default, mode filter/order/limit, empty state, exception handling and rate limiting (app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:33-96, :111-162). Members tabs are in app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:55,:64 and resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:6-38. Routes at routes/web.php:59-60 and every required lang key exists in lang/en/ui.php and lang/pt_BR/ui.php.

conventions.evidence: Good: domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:84,131,222), policies via $this->authorize (:57,96,117,etc.), #[Locked] on server context (Queues.php:23; Serve.php:33,44), reusable x-label/x-input, private helpers. Deviations: client-writable input properties $name and $renameName have no #[Validate] and create()/rename() never call $this->validate() (Queues.php:29,46,81,130); $mode is validated inline instead of via #[Validate] (Serve.php:42,71); no CHANGELOG/docs update anywhere in the diff.

security.evidence: Every state-changing action resolves models scoped to the entity and authorizes: openQueue/startRename/toggleActive/openAccess (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:92,108,157,168) and changeAccess for both grant and revoke (:215-222). Serve authorizes view on mount and delegates call authorization to CallNextTicket (:57-92; QueuePolicy via Gate::allows in waitingTickets :146); foreign ids throw ModelNotFoundException, lastCalledTicketId is #[Locked] (Serve.php:44,84). All output uses auto-escaping {{ }}. Gap: user-supplied name/renameName/mode are not validated at the component boundary (Queues.php:29,46; Serve.php:42), relying solely on downstream actions.

tests.evidence: Substantial Pest coverage: employee 403 and per-row-only markup (tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:25,:32), slug derivation and domain errors (:46), rename/collision (:66), confirmation modal (:86), nested reset (:111), grant/revoke (:128), foreign ids (:147), accessQueueId tamper (:165), English rendering (:178); ServePanelTest covers non-member 403 (:27), default queue (:34), grant filtering (:47), call order/mode (:63), callNext (:77), no selection/inactive (:92), foreign queue + locked property (:106) and rate limiting (:121). Missing: no route-level 403 test for entity.serve and Queues actions are only covered indirectly through mount authorization.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing Actions, the x-label/x-input components and the members-page modal/row pattern; helpers stay private and small (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:215,230,243,248). Minor excess: grant lookup filters in PHP instead of a targeted query (Queues.php:230-241) and the modal markup is repeated per page.

readability.evidence: Clear names, short docblocks and small focused methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:215-256; Serve.php:111-162). Small inconsistencies: public action parameters are untyped while properties are typed (Queues.php:92,108,157,168,183), and one test binds an unused, misleadingly named $owner (tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php:129).

scope.evidence: The diff only touches the members component/view, adds Queues/Serve components, views, routes, navbar entries and both locale files, plus tests. Extra lang keys added (e.g. queues_reactivate, serve_rate_limited) are all used; no unrelated refactors or files (change.diff:1-1319).

issues.explanation: The client-writable properties $name and $renameName have no #[Validate] rules or rules() method, and create()/rename() never call $this->validate(), contrary to the project's mandatory Livewire policy; input validation is only whatever CreateQueue/UpdateQueue happen to enforce.

$mode is validated with an ad-hoc inline $this->validate() call inside callNext() instead of the project's #[Validate] pattern, and render() silently falls back to CallMode::Any for an invalid value (Serve.php:148).
No CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] (nor any docs update) ships with this new user-facing feature, which the 'Keep docs in sync' convention requires.

closeCreate/closeQueue/cancelRename/cancelToggle/closeAccess are public actions that never call $this->authorize(), a literal deviation from 'authorize every action'; impact is nil because they only clear local state.

Serve authorization is only asserted on the component, with no test that GET entity.serve returns 403 for a non-member, and Queues actions are covered only indirectly through the mount check rather than per-action unauthorized calls.

$activeTab is a public property, so a client can set any string directly and bypass the whitelist in setActiveTab(); the view then treats it as non-'invites' and shows the members list, so it is harmless but the 'anything else is ignored' contract is enforced only in the method.
The access-modal test destructures the third value of queuesSetup() into $owner (it is actually the actor's membership) and never uses it, which is misleading.

Public action parameters ($queueId, $membershipId) are untyped while the corresponding properties are typed, unlike the project's otherwise typed style; declaring them int would fail fast on tampered payloads.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page and Serve panel as Livewire components with entity-scoped lookups, policy checks, modals, lang keys, routes and navbar entries, and splits the members page into members/invites tabs, backed by thorough Pest coverage of the happy paths, foreign-id and tamper cases. Requirements are essentially fully met and no exploitable weakness was found; the main gaps are the missing #[Validate] rules on client-writable input (validation delegated to the domain actions), the absent CHANGELOG/docs update, and a few minor test and readability nits.
